scope: Synthetic observation-design study, not measured Remote ID performance
assumptions: M1 simultaneous co-located receive chains measure the same physical packet; switching separate packets is a separate failure experiment
Analytic azimuth-only antenna pattern 6*(cos(theta-phi)-1) dB; not a measured antenna or reproduction of Han/Jang
No elevation information, no range from the directional signature, no hardware or BLE capture
Common scalar transmitter power, honest observers, known observer positions/orientations and event/claim timestamp association
M0-stat is a distribution-dependent baseline; M0-free profiles out unrestricted power and always abstains
Calibration/test flights are disjoint; thresholds use only normal calibration data
Main full-reception comparison omits sensitivity and packet losses; robustness scenarios add them explicitly
Independent calibration and test GNSS perturbations; no relay/clone/receiver-specific beamforming
Time gaps are separate local encounters, not simultaneous bearings or a continuous day-long flight
All trajectories and coordinates are fictional; no true aircraft or observer data
